Definition: Jithran, the name of an Edomite and of an Israelite
BiblicalUsage: Ithran = "advantage"; 1) an Edomite, son of Dishon, a Horite, and probably a phylarch of a tribe of the Horim; 2) an descendant of Asher
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
